title: Locate Jinzo

{{Quest infobox | name = Locate Jinzo | campaign = Factions | nationality = Canthan | map = [[Image:Locate Jinzo map.jpg|250px]] | region = Shing Jea Island | type = Primary | given by = [[Headmaster Lee]] | given at = [[Shing Jea Monastery]] | preceded by = [[Seek Out Headmaster Lee]],
[[Speak with Headmaster Lee %28Assassin%29]] | followed by = [[Opening Strike]] | profession = Assassin | primary = y | secondary = n }} This quest will instruct you to leave the monastery to find the first Assassin trainer, [[Jinzo]]. ==Quest information== ===Requirements=== {{ Standard prerequisites | campaign = factions | profession = Assassin | primary = y | secondary = n }} ===Objectives=== * Search [[Sunqua Vale]] for Jinzo. ===Early benefits=== * Headmaster Lee will teach you the following skills upon accepting the quest: *{{skill icon|Unsuspecting Strike}} *{{skill icon|Dancing Daggers}} *{{skill icon|Shadow Refuge}} ===Reward=== * 100 [[Experience]] * 10 [[Gold]] ==Walkthrough== Map travel to [[Shing Jea Monastery]] and speak with [[Headmaster Lee]] to obtain the quest. Exit Shing Jea Monastery and run north towards Sunqua Vale. You will find Jinzo standing in front of a large stone wall by the side of the road. ==NPCs== ===Allies=== [[Human]] *{{a}} 1 [[Vun Ying]] ==Dialogue== ===Initial dialogue=== ;Headmaster Lee ''The Assassin's path is one walked on a razor's edge. One must learn to balance one's judgment as well as one's blades. My two apprentices can teach you much about being an Assassin, and about balance. One is an extremely talented young man named Jinzo, the other is Panaku. They are two sides of the same coin. Jinzo thinks of his path in terms of duty, Panaku in terms of pleasure. If you are ready to begin, find [[Jinzo]] in [[Sunqua Vale]] for your first lesson.'' ''Grenth bless your blades.'' {{ Offer dialog | accept = I will look for Jinzo. | decline = I'm not ready. | ask = [[Jinzo]] awaits you at Yundin Circle, the training area west of Zhengjo Cavern in [[Sunqua Vale]]. }} ===Reward dialogue=== ;Jinzo ''Headmaster Lee is very wise, and I am honored to hear of her praise. I do not judge Panaku, but I do not claim to understand him, either. I was born an Assassin in a family of Monks, and I am accustomed to being misunderstood, so in that way, we are similar, Panaku and I. Life and death are gifts from the gods, but each has its price.'' ''Enough philosophy; it is time to begin your training.''
